title: MailboxRole serde/Display duplicate match arms vs macro in submission.rs
description: mailbox.rs MailboxRole has three identical match arms (Serialize impl, Deserialize visitor, Display impl). submission.rs has impl_string_enum_serde! macro that collapses Serialize+Deserialize into one declaration. MailboxRole predates the macro and was never updated. Suggested rewrite: move impl_string_enum_serde! to a shared private module (e.g. src/string_enum.rs), extend it to also emit Display, then apply it to MailboxRole. Adding a new variant today requires touching 3 files/impl blocks; after the fix, 1.
